rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Browser automation server built on Patchright that enables session inheritance from existing browser installations. Automatically copies cookies, localStorage, IndexedDB, and session storage from Chrome, Edge, or Chromium profiles, allowing automated workflows to leverage existing authentication states. Includes cross-platform credential decryption for macOS (Keychain), Windows (DPAPI), and Linux (libsecret). Provides tools for launching browsers, navigating pages, interacting with elements, extracting content, and capturing screenshots.
